scientific_integrity: Exact-degree, parity-compatible sampling; finite exact rational checker plus separate analytic tail; independent external validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite spectral ranks and inequalities through degree 119 are machine-checkable by supplied standalone exact code.
Degrees at least 120 are covered by a separate analytic Bernstein–Gershgorin proof.
Novelty comparisons are bounded; older cubature and octahedral-harmonic literature may contain equivalent results.
One older relevant polyhedral-grid reference was accessible by abstract only.
No unrestricted fourteen-point single-degree interpolation claim.
title: All-degree harmonic sampling and sharp stability on the radially normalized rhombic dodecahedron
